rice.reason: Unprocessed whole grain — zero sodium, virtually zero sugar and saturated fat.

basmati.reason: Premium natural cereal grain — naturally low in fat and sodium.

wheat.reason: Wholesome cereal grain rich in dietary fiber and essential minerals.

atta.reason: Whole wheat flour — high complex carbohydrates and low fat.

dal.reason: Legume / pulse rich in plant protein and dietary fiber.

pulses.reason: Plant protein source with zero cholesterol and minimal saturated fat.

oats.reason: Whole grain with high beta-glucan soluble fiber.

milk.reason: Nutritious dairy beverage with natural lactose and calcium.

curd.reason: Probiotic fermented dairy — good protein and calcium.

yogurt.reason: Fermented dairy product; check for added sweetening.

tea.reason: Zero calorie natural herbal infusion / brew.

green tea.reason: Rich in catechins and polyphenols with near zero calories.

coffee.reason: Unsweetened brewed coffee with zero fat and sugar.

juice.reason: Fruit beverage — contains natural and added sugars; consume in moderation.

bread.reason: Bakery product — moderate sodium and carbohydrates.

brown bread.reason: Whole grain bread enriched with dietary fiber.

multigrain bread.reason: Multi-seed whole grain bread with good fiber and low saturated fat.

noodles.reason: Instant noodles typically high in sodium (>800mg) and refined fats.

maggi.reason: Refined flour cake with high sodium tastemaker mix — limit consumption.

chips.reason: Deep fried potato / corn snack — high in saturated fat and sodium.

biscuit.reason: Processed baked confectionery — high refined sugar and vegetable fat.

cookies.reason: High in added sugar (>25g) and saturated bakery fats.

chocolate.reason: High calorie confectionery with substantial saturated fat and sugars.
